_comment: Animation takes for the anime cast (Tools/dai/anime). Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Fall, Land, Duel, Swim and Tread are solved on the cast skeleton by Tools/dai/anime/gait.py / build.py (biomechanical foot planting and leg IK); the gestures below are CC0 Quaternius takes retargeted onto the shared anime skeleton, with their legs re-solved so the feet stay planted. 'take' = source action name (after the last '|'); optional 'frames' [first, last], 'speed' (playback multiplier) and 'arm_drop' (degrees: the astronaut's bulky suit holds the arms away from the body). 'anime_models': existing anime base models (VRM / glTF / FBX humanoids) the cast is built from (Tools/dai/anime/models.py); drop your own in Tools/thirdparty/<pack>/<asset>/ with a SOURCE.txt and register them here.
